content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 15 vacancies are available – 1 for Controller of Examinations, 2 for Registrar, 2 for System Analyst, 3 for Computer Programmer, 1 for Purchase Officer, 1 for Data Processing Assistant Grade A, 3 for Assistant Registrar, 1 for Assistant Controller of Examinations, and 1 for Accounts Officer.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER). It is a prestigious medical institution located in Puducherry, offering various career opportunities in the government sector.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: JIPMER is recruiting for various Group A & B posts, including Controller of Examinations, Registrar, System Analyst, Computer Programmer, Purchase Officer, Data Processing Assistant Grade A, Assistant Registrar, and Accounts Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are there in this JIPMER recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies for Various Group A & B Posts under the JIPMER Recruitment 2026. These positions offer a great chance for eligible candidates to join a central government institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for JIPMER Various Posts?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their offline applications for the JIPMER Various Group A & B Posts Recruitment 2026 is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application for the JIPMER Various Group A & B Posts Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these JIPMER posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying to the Various Group A & B Posts in JIPMER Recruitment 2026 is 56 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned for these deputation posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the JIPMER Various Group A & B Posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the JIPMER Various Group A & B Posts ranges from Level-7 to Level-12 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC). Specific post salaries vary from ₹44900-142400 to ₹78800-209200.

faq.question: Q8. What are the minimum qualifications required for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need qualifications such as a Master's Degree, Bachelor's Degree, B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science/IT, Post Graduate Diploma in Materials Management, Chartered Accountant, or SAS Exam, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for JIPMER Various Posts Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the JIPMER Various Group A & B Posts Recruitment 2026. Candidates from all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST, are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for JIPMER Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for JIPMER Various Group A & B Posts involves application through proper channel, document verification, No Objection Certificate, Vigilance Clearance, and APAR Review. There is no written exam or interview mentioned.
